bio.short: Born and raised on Amelia Island, Raegan Heymann is a Realtor and co-owner of Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Heymann Williams Realty. She has spent more than a decade helping people find, sell, and build homes on the island she has always called home.
paragraphs: Raegan grew up on Amelia Island, which means she knows it the way only a native can: which streets catch the morning light, where the marsh goes gold in October, and which blocks quietly hold their value year after year.

She graduated from the University of North Florida in 2003 and built her early career in finance and mortgage servicing. That background still shapes how she works: every recommendation is grounded in the numbers, and every contract is read the way a lender would read it.

Since moving into real estate she has been a consistent top producer, with more than 300 closed sales across Amelia Island, Fernandina Beach, and the Nassau County mainland. As co-owner of Heymann Williams Realty she has also been involved in residential development projects on the island, giving her a builder's-eye view of what is coming next.
Raegan lives on the island with her family. If you call, you reach her.
